description: The figure presents three separate pie charts summarizing human pairwise comparison outcomes across three datasets (Truthful Review, Funny Reddit, and Unhealthy Comments), showing the distribution of preferences among three categories. Each pie chart contains 3 slices corresponding to “W/o Demos” (light gray), “Hard to Tell” (blue), and “W/ Demos” (mint green), with percentage values labeled inside the slices. In the Truthful Review chart, the gray “W/o Demos” slice is 43.0%, the blue “Hard to Tell” slice is 22.9%, and the green “W/ Demos” slice is 34.1%. In the Funny Reddit chart, “W/o Demos” (gray) is 41.5%, “Hard to Tell” (blue) is 21.5%, and “W/ Demos” (green) is 37.1%. In the Unhealthy Comments chart, “W/o Demos” (gray) is 37.8%, “Hard to Tell” (blue) is 27.4%, and “W/ Demos” (green) is 34.8%. A legend appears at the top mapping colors to labels, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a single consistent sequence.
